resolved_findings: Canonical input and protected paths close overlap-normalization gaps.
Both transport archive and sibling receipt are checked against protected and selected inputs.
Scope, metadata, and payload require strict UTF-8 without NUL.
Pre/post transport verification binds exact package-index identity.
Canonical logical names prevent normalized duplicate mismatch.
Dangling required build metadata symlinks are rejected.
Fixture module loads verified source bytes rather than timestamp bytecode caches.
Lean .ilean artifacts are refused even when valid UTF-8 JSON.
Prepared unpack placeholder identifies archive SHA from transport receipt.
reviewed_semantics: All selected attempt receipts and compiler logs, including failed/interrupted attempts and empty logs, are retained; incomplete and START-only records remain visible.
Artifact, stage, and superseded payload subtrees are excluded.
Selected text is copied byte-exact or split with original/part lengths and SHA-256 hashes; verification reconstructs original bytes and rejects unexpected members.
Complete selected inventories and hashes are compared before and after capture.
Capture and unpack use new destinations without overwriting existing output.
Transport and unpack verify content and reject unsafe archive members.
The package records evidence only and has no proof-acceptance logic.
limits: Actual quiescence is a caller assertion and must be established separately.
Cooperative filesystem writers are assumed; this is not protection against a hostile concurrent filesystem actor.
No final capture or actual unpack was executed by this reviewer.
Missing final source bytes and latest prepared metadata cannot be reverified from this reconstructed record.
